note: Radar values are spec 4.1, approved by Mauro on 11 Oct 2026 (section 11). Lore and difficulty are screen copy. Body options are the creation set from section 11: face (4, inside 3-5), skin (8), hair (8 plus custom), eyes (8 plus custom). Armour dye is not here; that is a later premium-shop package.

kestrel.lore: Kestrel fights from far away. Mark Shot sets a target up, and Detonate finishes it. A ranged carry, light on armour and lighter on healing.

ironjaw.lore: Ironjaw closes the gap and stays in it. Advance, Strike, Shoulder and Crush are a melee bruiser's whole plan, in dark steel.

mender.lore: Mender keeps people standing. Mend and Pulse Tap heal, Ward and Cleanse hold the line, and Heartstop is the last word.

gloam.lore: Gloam is gone until the strike lands. Fade, Ambush and the shade spells make a stealth assassin, not a front line.

bastion.lore: Bastion plants its feet and does not give ground. Bash, Hold Line and Aegis are a tank's tools.
